verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה וְגַֽם־ אִגְּרוֹת֙ כָּתַב֙ עַל־ אֶפְרַ֣יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָב֥וֹא לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת פֶּ֔סַח לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh wə·ḡam- ’ig·gə·rō·wṯ kā·ṯaḇ ‘al- ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh lā·ḇō·w lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim la·‘ă·śō·wṯ pe·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah sent word throughout all Israel and Judah and he also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh inviting them to come to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem to keep the Passover of the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ezequias enviou por todo o Israel e Judá e escreveu também cartas a Efraim e a Manassés, para que viessem à Casa de Jeová em Jerusalém, a fim de celebrarem a Páscoa a Jeová, Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֨ץ הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֛יו וְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הַפֶּ֖סַח בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ham·me·leḵ wə·śā·rāw wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl bî·rū·šā·lim la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hap·pe·saḥ ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî
verses.literal: For the king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem had decided to keep the Passover in the second month
verses.literalPt: Pois o rei, e todos os seus príncipes, e toda a congregação em Jerusalém tinham tomado conselho, para celebrarem a Páscoa no segundo mês.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יָכְל֛וּ לַעֲשֹׂת֖וֹ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא כִּ֤י הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ לֹֽא־ הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְמַדַּ֔י וְהָעָ֖ם לֹא־ נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ לִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·ḵə·lū la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw bā·‘êṯ ha·hî kî hak·kō·hă·nîm lō- hiṯ·qad·də·šū lə·mad·day wə·hā·‘ām lō- ne·’es·p̄ū lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: since they had been unable . . . to keep it at the regular . . . time because not enough priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not been gathered in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Não tinham podido celebrar no tempo próprio, porque os sacerdotes não se tinham santificado em número suficiente, e porque não se tinha ajuntado ainda o povo em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיִּישַׁ֥ר הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·šar had·dā·ḇār bə·‘ê·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê kāl- haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: This plan pleased . . . the king and the whole assembly
verses.literalPt: Foi isso reto aos olhos do rei e de toda a congregação.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲמִ֣ידוּ דָבָ֗ר לְהַעֲבִ֨יר ק֤וֹל בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִבְּאֵֽר־ שֶׁ֣בַע וְעַד־ דָּ֔ן לָב֞וֹא לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּ֛סַח לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָרֹ֛ב עָשׂ֖וּ כַּכָּתֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏū ḏā·ḇār lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr qō·wl bə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl mib·bə·’êr- še·ḇa‘ wə·‘aḏ- dān lā·ḇō·w la·‘ă·śō·wṯ pe·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl bî·rū·šā·lim kî lō lā·rōḇ ‘ā·śū kak·kā·ṯūḇ
verses.literal: So they established a decree to circulate a proclamation throughout Israel from Beersheba to Dan that the people should come to keep the Passover of the LORD the God of Israel in Jerusalem For they had not observed it in great numbers as prescribed
verses.literalPt: Decretaram que se fizesse pregão em todo o Israel, desde Berseba até Dã, para que viessem celebrar em Jerusalém a Páscoa a Jeová, Deus de Israel; porque não a celebravam mais com grande número de assistentes como está escrito.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ הָרָצִ֨ים בָּֽאִגְּר֜וֹת מִיַּ֧ד הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֗יו בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּכְמִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיָשֹׁב֙ אֶל־ הַפְּלֵיטָ֔ה הַנִּשְׁאֶ֣רֶת לָכֶ֔ם מִכַּ֖ף מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū hā·rā·ṣîm bā·’ig·gə·rō·wṯ mî·yaḏ ham·me·leḵ wə·śā·rāw bə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh ū·ḵə·miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ lê·mōr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl šū·ḇū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām yiṣ·ḥāq wə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·šōḇ ’el- hap·pə·lê·ṭāh han·niš·’e·reṯ lā·ḵem mik·kap̄ mal·ḵê ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: At the command of the king the couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and his officials which read Children of Israel return to the LORD the God of Abraham Isaac and Israel so that He may return to those of you who remain who have escaped the grasp of the kings of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Partiram os correios com as cartas do rei e dos seus príncipes para todo o Israel e Judá, dizendo segundo o mandamento do rei: Filhos de Israel, tornai para Jeová, Deus de Abraão, de Isaque e de Israel, para que ele se torne para os restos que de vós escaparam das mãos dos reis da Assíria.

verses.original: וְאַל־ תִּֽהְי֗וּ כַּאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְכַ֣אֲחֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲל֔וּ בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְּנֵ֣ם לְשַׁמָּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tih·yū ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·ḵa·’ă·ḥê·ḵem ’ă·šer mā·‘ă·lū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem way·yit·tə·nêm lə·šam·māh ka·’ă·šer ’at·tem rō·’îm
verses.literal: Do not be like your fathers and brothers who were unfaithful to the LORD the God of their fathers so that He made them an object of horror as you can see
verses.literalPt: Não sejais como vossos pais e como vossos irmãos, que cometeram transgressões contra Jeová, Deus de vossos pais, de sorte que os entregou à desolação, como vós estais vendo.

verses.original: עַתָּ֕ה אַל־ תַּקְשׁ֥וּ עָרְפְּכֶ֖ם כַּאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם תְּנוּ־ יָ֣ד לַיהוָ֗ה וּבֹ֤אוּ לְמִקְדָּשׁוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֣ישׁ לְעוֹלָ֔ם וְעִבְדוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְיָשֹׁ֥ב מִכֶּ֖ם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ’al- taq·šū ‘ā·rə·pə·ḵem ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem tə·nū- yāḏ Yah·weh ū·ḇō·’ū lə·miq·dā·šōw ’ă·šer hiq·dîš lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·yā·šōḇ mik·kem ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: Now do not stiffen your necks as your fathers did Submit . . . to the LORD and come to His sanctuary which He has consecrated forever Serve the LORD your God so that His fierce anger . . . will turn away from you
verses.literalPt: Não endureçais a vossa cerviz, como o fizeram vossos pais; mas submetei-vos a Jeová, e entrai no santuário, que ele santificou para sempre, e servi a Jeová, vosso Deus, para que se desvie de vós o furor da sua ira.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְשׁוּבְכֶ֞ם עַל־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲחֵיכֶ֨ם וּבְנֵיכֶ֤ם לְרַחֲמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י שֽׁוֹבֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָשׁ֖וּב לָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את כִּֽי־ חַנּ֤וּן וְרַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־ יָסִ֤יר פָּנִים֙ מִכֶּ֔ם אִם־ תָּשׁ֖וּבוּ אֵלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·šū·ḇə·ḵem ‘al- Yah·weh ’ă·ḥê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem lə·ra·ḥă·mîm lip̄·nê šō·w·ḇê·hem wə·lā·šūḇ lā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ kî- ḥan·nūn wə·ra·ḥūm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·lō- yā·sîr pā·nîm mik·kem ’im- tā·šū·ḇū ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: For if you return to the LORD your brothers and sons will receive mercy in the presence of their captors and will return to this land For the LORD your God is gracious and merciful He will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him
verses.literalPt: Se voltardes para Jeová, vossos irmãos e vossos filhos acharão misericórdia diante dos que os levaram cativos e tornarão para esta terra; porque Jeová, vosso Deus, é clemente e misericordioso e não apartará de vós o seu rosto, se voltardes para ele.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֨וּ הָרָצִ֜ים עֹבְרִ֨ים מֵעִ֧יר׀ לָעִ֛יר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְעַד־ זְבֻל֑וּן וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ מַשְׂחִיקִ֣ים עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמַלְעִגִ֖ים בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū hā·rā·ṣîm ‘ō·ḇə·rîm mê·‘îr lā·‘îr bə·’e·reṣ- ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh wə·‘aḏ- zə·ḇu·lūn way·yih·yū maś·ḥî·qîm ‘ă·lê·hem ū·mal·‘i·ḡîm bām
verses.literal: And the couriers traveled from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh as far as Zebulun . . . but the people scorned . . . and mocked them
verses.literalPt: Passaram os correios de cidade em cidade, pelo país de Efraim e Manassés, até Zebulom; mas riam-se deles e zombavam.

verses.original: אַךְ־ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מֵאָשֵׁ֥ר וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּמִזְּבֻל֑וּן נִֽכְנְע֔וּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- ’ă·nā·šîm mê·’ā·šêr ū·mə·naš·šeh ū·miz·zə·ḇu·lūn niḵ·nə·‘ū way·yā·ḇō·’ū lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Nevertheless some from Asher Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Todavia, alguns de Aser, de Manassés e de Zebulom se humilharam e foram a Jerusalém.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בִּיהוּדָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ יַ֣ד הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם לֵ֣ב אֶחָ֑ד לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִ֖ים בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam bî·hū·ḏāh hā·yə·ṯāh yaḏ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem lêḇ ’e·ḥāḏ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Moreover the power of God was on the people in Judah to give them one heart to obey the command of the king and his officials according to the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também em Judá se manifestou a mão de Jeová, dando-lhes um só coração para cumprir o que o rei e os príncipes mandaram pela palavra de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֵּֽאָסְפ֤וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עַם־ רָ֔ב לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶת־ חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֑י קָהָ֖ל לָרֹ֥ב מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū yə·rū·šā·lim ‘am- rāḇ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî qā·hāl lā·rōḇ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: In the second month a very great assembly . . . . . . gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread
verses.literalPt: Reuniu-se em Jerusalém muito povo para celebrar a Festa dos Pães Asmos no segundo mês, uma congregação mui grande.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֕מוּ וַיָּסִ֙ירוּ֙ אֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַֽמְקַטְּרוֹת֙ הֵסִ֔ירוּ וַיַּשְׁלִ֖יכוּ לְנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū way·yā·sî·rū ’eṯ- ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim wə·’êṯ kāl- ham·qaṭ·ṭə·rō·wṯ hê·sî·rū way·yaš·lî·ḵū lə·na·ḥal qiḏ·rō·wn
verses.literal: They proceeded to remove the altars in Jerusalem - and to take away the incense altars and throw them into the Kidron Valley
verses.literalPt: Levantaram-se, e tiraram os altares que havia em Jerusalém, e também tiraram todos os altares do incenso, e lançaram-nos na torrente de Cedrom.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַפֶּ֔סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֤ם נִכְלְמוּ֙ וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ עֹל֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hap·pe·saḥ bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim niḵ·lə·mū way·yiṯ·qad·də·šū way·yā·ḇî·’ū ‘ō·lō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And on the fourteenth . . . day of the second month they slaughtered the Passover lamb The priests and Levites were ashamed and they consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então, imolaram a Páscoa no décimo quarto dia do segundo mês; os sacerdotes e os levitas se envergonharam, e se santificaram, e trouxeram holocaustos para a Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַמְד֤וּ עַל־ עָמְדָם֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם כְּתוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ זֹרְקִ֣ים אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם מִיַּ֖ד הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- ‘ā·mə·ḏām kə·miš·pā·ṭām kə·ṯō·w·raṯ mō·šeh ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hak·kō·hă·nîm zō·rə·qîm ’eṯ- had·dām mî·yaḏ hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: They stood at their prescribed posts according to the Law of Moses the man of God The priests splattered the blood which they received from the hand of the Levites
verses.literalPt: Tomaram os seus lugares segundo a sua ordem, conforme a lei de Moisés, homem de Deus; os sacerdotes aspergiam o sangue que recebiam das mãos dos levitas.

verses.original: כִּי־ רַבַּ֥ת בַּקָּהָ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם עַל־ שְׁחִיטַ֣ת הַפְּסָחִ֗ים לְכֹל֙ לֹ֣א טָה֔וֹר לְהַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- rab·baṯ baq·qā·hāl ’ă·šer lō- hiṯ·qad·dā·šū wə·hal·wî·yim ‘al- šə·ḥî·ṭaṯ hap·pə·sā·ḥîm lə·ḵōl lō ṭā·hō·wr lə·haq·dîš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Since there were many in the assembly who had not consecrated themselves the Levites were in charge of slaughtering the Passover lambs for every unclean person . . . to consecrate the lambs to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Havia muitos na congregação que não se haviam santificado; portanto, os levitas estavam encarregados de matar os cordeiros da Páscoa por todos aqueles que não estavam limpos para os santificarem a Jeová.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַרְבִּ֣ית הָעָ֡ם רַ֠בַּת מֵֽאֶפְרַ֨יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה יִשָּׂשכָ֤ר וּזְבֻלוּן֙ לֹ֣א הִטֶּהָ֔רוּ כִּֽי־ אָכְל֥וּ אֶת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח בְּלֹ֣א כַכָּת֑וּב כִּי֩ הִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֥ה הַטּ֖וֹב יְכַפֵּ֥ר בְּעַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî mar·bîṯ hā·‘ām rab·baṯ mê·’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh yiś·śā·š·ḵār ū·zə·ḇu·lūn lō hiṭ·ṭe·hā·rū kî- ’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- hap·pe·saḥ bə·lō ḵak·kā·ṯūḇ kî hiṯ·pal·lêl yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘ă·lê·hem lê·mōr Yah·weh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ yə·ḵap·pêr bə·‘aḏ
verses.literal: A large number of the people many from Ephraim Manasseh Issachar and Zebulun had not purified themselves yet they ate the Passover contrary to what was written But Hezekiah interceded for them saying May the LORD who is good provide atonement for everyone
verses.literalPt: Pois uma multidão do povo, muitos de Efraim, de Manassés, de Issacar e de Zebulom, não se tinham purificado; contudo, comeram a Páscoa ainda que não segundo o que está escrito. Porquanto Ezequias tinha orado por eles, dizendo: Jeová, que é bom, perdoe a todo aquele

verses.original: כָּל־ לְבָב֣וֹ הֵכִ֔ין לִדְר֛וֹשׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֑יו וְלֹ֖א כְּטָהֳרַ֥ת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- lə·ḇā·ḇōw hê·ḵîn liḏ·rō·wōš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāw wə·lō kə·ṭā·ho·raṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: who sets his heart on seeking God the LORD the God of his fathers even if he is not cleansed according to the purification rules of the sanctuary
verses.literalPt: que propõe no seu coração buscar a Deus, a saber, Jeová, Deus de seus pais, ainda que não seja purificado segundo a purificação do santuário.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּרְפָּ֖א אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh ’el- yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yir·pā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . heard Hezekiah and healed the people
verses.literalPt: Jeová deu ouvidos a Ezequias e sarou o povo.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל הַנִּמְצְאִ֨ים בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת־ חַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּשִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וּֽמְהַלְלִ֣ים לַ֠יהוָה י֣וֹם׀ בְּי֞וֹם הַלְוִיִּ֧ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים בִּכְלֵי־ עֹ֖ז לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl han·nim·ṣə·’îm bī·rū·šå̄·lam ’eṯ- ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm bə·śim·ḥāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh ū·mə·hal·lîm Yah·weh yō·wm bə·yō·wm hal·wî·yim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm biḵ·lê- ‘ōz Yah·weh
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . who were present in Jerusalem celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great joy and the Levites and priests praised the LORD day after day accompanied by loud instruments of praise to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel que se acharam em Jerusalém celebraram a Festa dos Pães Asmos, por sete dias, com grande alegria; e os levitas e os sacerdotes louvaram a Jeová de dia em dia, cantando a Jeová ao som de instrumentos altissonantes.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל־ לֵב֙ כָּל־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַמַּשְׂכִּילִ֥ים שֵֽׂכֶל־ ט֖וֹב לַיהוָ֑ה וַיֹּאכְל֤וּ אֶת־ הַמּוֹעֵד֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֔ים מְזַבְּחִים֙ זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֔ים וּמִ֨תְוַדִּ֔ים לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ‘al- lêḇ kāl- hal·wî·yim ham·maś·kî·lîm śê·ḵel- ṭō·wḇ Yah·weh way·yō·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- ham·mō·w·‘êḏ šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm mə·zab·bə·ḥîm ziḇ·ḥê šə·lā·mîm ū·miṯ·wad·dîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: And Hezekiah encouraged . . . . . . all the Levites . . . who performed skillfully . . . before the LORD For seven days they ate their assigned portion sacrificing peace offerings and giving thanks to the LORD the God of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Ezequias falou benevolamente a todos os levitas que se achavam bem instruídos no serviço de Jeová. Comeram durante os sete dias da festa, oferecendo ofertas e louvando a Jeová, Deus de seus pais.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּֽעֲצוּ֙ כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ שִׁבְעַת־ יָמִ֖ים שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘ă·ṣū kāl- haq·qā·hāl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·ya·‘ă·śū šiḇ·‘aṯ- yā·mîm śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: The whole assembly agreed to observe seven more days so they observed seven days with joy
verses.literalPt: Toda a congregação resolveu celebrar outros sete dias e celebraram outros sete dias com alegria.

verses.original: כִּ֣י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְ֠הוּדָה הֵרִ֨ים לַקָּהָ֜ל אֶ֣לֶף פָּרִים֮ וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֣ים צֹאן֒ס וְהַשָּׂרִ֞ים הֵרִ֤ימוּ לַקָּהָל֙ פָּרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְצֹ֖אן עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ כֹהֲנִ֖ים לָרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh hê·rîm laq·qā·hāl ’e·lep̄ pā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ṣō·ns wə·haś·śā·rîm hê·rî·mū laq·qā·hāl pā·rîm ’e·lep̄ wə·ṣōn ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm way·yiṯ·qad·də·šū ḵō·hă·nîm lā·rōḇ
verses.literal: For Hezekiah king of Judah contributed a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep for the assembly and the officials contributed a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep for the assembly and a great number of priests consecrated themselves
verses.literalPt: Pois Ezequias, rei de Judá, deu à congregação para se oferecerem mil novilhos e sete mil ovelhas; e os príncipes deram à congregação mil novilhos e dez mil ovelhas. Um grande número de sacerdotes se santificou.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׂמְח֣וּ׀ כָּל־ קְהַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל הַבָּאִ֣ים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַגֵּרִ֗ים הַבָּאִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִ֖ים בִּיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·mə·ḥū kāl- qə·hal yə·hū·ḏāh wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl hab·bā·’îm mî·yiś·rā·’êl wə·hag·gê·rîm hab·bā·’îm mê·’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl wə·hay·yō·wō·šə·ḇîm bî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Then the whole assembly of Judah rejoiced along with the priests and Levites and the whole assembly that had come from Israel including the foreigners who had come from Israel and those who lived in Judah
verses.literalPt: Toda a congregação de Judá, juntamente com os sacerdotes e os levitas, e toda a congregação que veio de Israel, e os estrangeiros que vieram da terra de Israel, e os que habitavam na terra de Judá se regozijaram.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָֽה־ גְדוֹלָ֖ה בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֠י מִימֵ֞י שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן־ דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א כָזֹ֖את בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî śim·ḥāh- ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh bî·rū·šā·lim kî mî·mê šə·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wîḏ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl lō ḵā·zōṯ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: So there was great rejoicing in Jerusalem for nothing like this had happened there since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel
verses.literalPt: Assim, houve grande alegria em Jerusalém, pois não tinha havido coisa semelhante em Jerusalém desde o tempo de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֜מוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַלְוִיִּם֙ וַיְבָרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וַיִּשָּׁמַ֖ע בְּקוֹלָ֑ם וַתָּב֧וֹא תְפִלָּתָ֛ם לִמְע֥וֹן קָדְשׁ֖וֹ לַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim way·ḇā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·yiš·šā·ma‘ bə·qō·w·lām wat·tā·ḇō·w ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯām lim·‘ō·wn qā·ḏə·šōw laš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then the priests and the Levites stood to bless the people and God heard their voice and their prayer came into His holy dwelling place in heaven
verses.literalPt: Então, os levitas sacerdotes se levantaram e abençoaram o povo; a sua voz foi ouvida, e a sua oração chegou até a santa habitação de Deus, até o céu.
